verdict.rationale: Formant is a robot fleet operations platform, so tooling for integrating vision-language-action or robotics foundation models into an autonomy stack is a fair question for it. The evidence pack shows no such tooling. What it does show is adjacent: fleet-level ML task recommendations, an analytics AI assistant, generic Agent SDK telemetry and command methods, and a marketing line about connecting "AI" and robots. None of these is documented support for running or integrating VLA or foundation models in on-robot autonomy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can integrate vision-language-action or robotics foundation models into my robot's autonomy stack through supported tooling
